bill.summary:
Combating Foreign Threats to Main Street Act of 2026
This bill requires the Small Business Administration to publish materials to educate small businesses about how they could be harmed by foreign adversary conduct such as cyber intrusions, fraud, intellectual property theft, or the use of forced labor.
The educational materials must (1) describe the conduct that poses such harm, (2) identify best practices for small businesses to protect sensitive information and supply chains, and (3) provide guidance for cybersecurity and data protection.
